content: Macadamia oil, also known as macadamia nut oil, is a non-volatile oil extracted from the nut meat of the macadamia tree (Macadamia integrifolia). It is commonly utilized in culinary applications as a frying or salad oil and in cosmetic formulations as an emollient or a fragrance fixative. Chemical Structure Macadamia oil is composed of approximately 60% oleic acid, 19% palmitoleic acid, 1-3% linoleic acid, and 1-2% linolenic acid. Certain varieties of macadamia oil exhibit a nearly equal balance of omega-6 and omega-3 fatty acids. Despite being cultivated in various regions worldwide, the fatty acid profile of macadamia oil remains relatively unaffected by environmental factors. Chemically, it shares properties typical of vegetable triglyceride oils and is highly stable due to its low polyunsaturated fat content. Physical Properties At room temperature, macadamia oil exists in a liquid state. The refined version of the oil is clear and has a light amber hue with a subtle nutty aroma. While it can be further refined to achieve complete transparency, a faint scent of macadamia nuts typically persists. Uses in Food Macadamia oil is an excellent choice for frying due to its high heat capacity. Its suitability as an edible oil is attributed to several key properties: It contains up to 85% monounsaturated fats. It has a shelf life of one to two years without refrigeration. It possesses a high smoke point of 410°F (210°C). Uses in Cosmetics Macadamia oil is highly valued in cosmetic formulations for its rich, cushiony texture on the skin and its exceptional oxidative stability. These characteristics make it particularly suitable for use in heavy creams and sun care products. Cosmetic derivatives of macadamia oil include ethyl macadamiate, a lightweight emollient, and PEG-16 macadamia glycerides, which are water-soluble. Additionally, macadamia oil serves as an excellent botanical alternative to mink oil in most applications. Its INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) name is Macadamia Integrifolia Seed Oil.
